patterns: What kind of questions can I ask
responses: Right now I can help with study tips, time management, staying motivated, and handling exam stress — plus general academic questions like exams, assignments, or attendance. Soon you'll be able to upload your own notes and PDFs so I can help you study from your own material.
Ask me for study tips, help managing your time, or a motivation boost — I'll do my best to help{name}! Uploading your own study material is coming soon.

patterns: What subjects are in this semester
What is the syllabus for this course
What topics are covered in this course
responses: You can find detailed course structure and subject list in the student portal under 'Academics > Course Details'.
Course details including credits and subjects are listed on the department notice board and student portal.

patterns: Where can I find the syllabus
responses: The syllabus is available on the college portal under 'Academics > Syllabus', unit-wise for every subject.
You can download the latest syllabus PDF from the department website or student portal.

patterns: What classes do I have today
responses: Your class timetable is available on the student portal under 'Timetable'. Make sure to check for any last-minute changes.
Check the notice board or portal for the latest timetable — it updates every semester.
The exam datesheet is usually released 2-3 weeks before exams on the student portal under 'Examinations'.
Please check the examination section of the portal for the latest exam schedule.

patterns: How do I prepare for exams
How do I manage exam stress
Where can I get previous year question papers
responses: Try the Pomodoro technique: 25 minutes focused study + 5 minute break. Also, solve previous years' papers and make short revision notes.
Prioritize high-weightage topics, practice past papers, sleep well before the exam, and avoid cramming the night before.
Create a revision timetable, focus on weak topics first, and take short breaks to keep your mind fresh.

patterns: I need help with my assignment
How do I submit my assignment
Where do I upload my assignment
responses: Assignments should be submitted via the LMS portal in PDF format. Check the assignment brief for word count and referencing style.
Structure your assignment with an introduction, body, and conclusion. Cite your sources properly, and submit before the deadline via the portal.

patterns: Is there an extension for the assignment
When do I need to submit my project
responses: Deadlines are posted on the LMS along with each assignment. Late submissions may attract a penalty unless an extension is approved.
Check the assignment tab on the portal for the exact due date and time.

patterns: How much attendance do I need
What happens if my attendance is low
Am I eligible for exams with low attendance
responses: Most programs require a minimum of 75% attendance to be eligible for exams. Check with your department for exact rules.
If your attendance falls below the required percentage, you may need to apply for condonation through your department.

patterns: How do I calculate my GPA
responses: Grading is typically done on a 10-point CGPA scale, combining internal assessments and end-semester exam marks.
Your final grade usually combines internal marks (assignments, attendance, tests) and external exam marks. Check your institution's grading policy for exact weightage.

patterns: How do I check my results
Where can I see my marks
responses: Results are usually published on the student portal within 3-4 weeks after exams end.
You can check your results by logging into the student portal under 'Examinations > Results'.

patterns: How do I borrow a book
responses: The library is usually open from 9 AM to 8 PM on weekdays. You can borrow up to 3 books at a time with your student ID.
Many institutions provide access to e-books and journals through the library's digital portal — check with your librarian for login details.

patterns: How do I improve my focus
responses: Try active recall and spaced repetition — test yourself instead of just re-reading notes. Study in short, focused sessions.
Remove distractions, set clear goals for each session, and use techniques like summarizing topics in your own words.
Break large topics into small chunks, use flashcards for quick revision, and teach concepts to a friend to reinforce learning.

patterns: How do I manage my time
How to balance studies and other activities
I have too much to study and no time
How to make a study schedule
responses: Use a weekly planner, prioritize tasks using the Eisenhower matrix (urgent vs important), and avoid multitasking.
Break your day into blocks for study, breaks, and personal time. Review and adjust your schedule weekly.

patterns: How do I deal with academic stress
I am anxious about my results
responses: It's normal to feel stressed. Try deep breathing, short walks, and breaking tasks into smaller steps. Don't hesitate to talk to a counselor if it gets overwhelming.
Take regular breaks, get enough sleep, and remember that one exam doesn't define you. You've got this{name}!
"Success is the sum of small efforts repeated day in and day out." Keep going{name}, you're closer than you think!
Every expert was once a beginner. Start with just 10 minutes of focused study — momentum will carry you forward.
"The future depends on what you do today." – Mahatma Gandhi. You've got this{name}!

patterns: How do I apply for a scholarship
responses: Scholarship details are usually listed on the college website under 'Financial Aid' or 'Scholarships'. Eligibility often depends on merit or income criteria.
Check with the accounts/scholarship office for merit-based and government scholarship schemes you may be eligible for.

patterns: How do I pay my fees
Where can I pay college fees
Is there a late fee for payment
responses: Fees can usually be paid online through the student portal via net banking, UPI, or card. Check the accounts office for the exact deadline.
Late fee payments may attract a penalty — check the fee schedule on the portal for exact due dates.

patterns: How do I apply for hostel
responses: Hostel applications are usually done through the student portal or the hostel warden's office at the start of the academic year.
Contact the hostel administration office for information on fees, room allotment, and rules.

patterns: How do I prepare for placements
responses: The placement cell usually begins drives in the final year. Check their notice board or portal for company visits and eligibility criteria.
Build your resume, practice aptitude tests and mock interviews, and stay updated through the placement cell's announcements.

patterns: How do I contact my professor
How do I reach my teacher
I want to talk to a professor
How do I meet my teacher
responses: Faculty contact details and office hours are usually listed on the department website or notice board.
You can email your professor directly or visit during their listed office hours — check the department portal for details.

patterns: I can't log into the portal
I am having a technical issue
responses: Try resetting your password using the 'Forgot Password' link. If the issue persists, contact the IT helpdesk.
Clear your browser cache or try a different browser. If the problem continues, reach out to your college's IT support team.
